about: keel's commands for terminal clients: keel TUI (cli/), the xal client (clients/xal) and any other front end. One table: names, arguments, help text, whether a command writes (decides a gate, starts or stops a flow), what its argument completes from, and local = it never calls keel, group = where /help lists it (groups gives their order). keel TUI builds its commands from it (cli/src/core/commands.ts, a test keeps both the same). Every request a client sends says who acts: X-Keel-Via (tui, xal, mcp), X-Keel-Client (its name and version) and X-Keel-Tool (the command); the api records a write as a <via>.call event.

commands.name: help
commands.summary: what keel TUI can do

commands.name: project
commands.summary: pick the project (or switch to one by name)

commands.name: flow
commands.summary: start a flow: pick the workflow, then say the idea

commands.name: flows
commands.summary: this project's flows, newest first

commands.name: resume
commands.summary: go on with a stopped or failed flow from its last saved step (the newest, or n from /flows)

commands.name: stop
commands.summary: stop the project's flow, all running and waiting ones, or one from /flows (finished steps stay saved)

commands.name: run
commands.summary: the flow's run mode: how much keel decides by itself, from the next gate on

commands.name: status
commands.summary: the flow: step, phase, criteria, what waits, tokens

commands.name: next
commands.summary: what to do next

commands.name: inbox
commands.summary: everything that waits for you, in every project

commands.name: approve
commands.summary: approve what waits (or inbox item n)

commands.name: reject
commands.summary: send back what waits, with the reason

commands.name: answer
commands.summary: answer a gate's questions or choose one of its exits

commands.name: jobs
commands.summary: the project's agent calls, newest first

commands.name: agent
commands.summary: the agents at work and the ones you started: open one to follow it live; new starts one in its own worktree

commands.name: live
commands.summary: the agents at work now and their last step

commands.name: steps
commands.summary: the flow's steps with their state (or one agent call's steps)

commands.name: timeline
commands.summary: what happened: steps and agent runs, newest first

commands.name: workflows
commands.summary: the project's workflows, and a workflow as a diagram

commands.name: create
commands.summary: a new workflow, rule pack, agent, skill or stack: KeelBot writes it (or from a file; a stack also from keel's guided questions), keel checks it, you save it

commands.name: diagram
commands.summary: keel's diagrams in ASCII

commands.name: rules
commands.summary: keel's rules for this project, and what agents may change right now

commands.name: skills
commands.summary: the project's skills and the agents that load each; market: the marketplace's skills

commands.name: skill
commands.summary: one skill's text; attach or detach puts it on agents or takes it off; install brings one from the marketplace

commands.name: stacks
commands.summary: how this project builds and tests: every stack keel knows, which ones it uses or turned off; market: the marketplace's stacks

commands.name: stack
commands.summary: one stack and its YAML; remove one the project added; turn one off or on for the project; install one from the marketplace or a keel pack

commands.name: plugins
commands.summary: the plugins keel has, and which are on here

commands.name: budget
commands.summary: tokens and money today, this month, per flow, and the caps

commands.name: dashboard
commands.summary: the dashboard's link for this project

commands.name: model
commands.summary: KeelBot's model (from keel's catalog)

commands.name: effort
commands.summary: KeelBot's thinking effort on its model (default clears it)

commands.name: chats
commands.summary: earlier KeelBot chats of this project, newest first with the last message: type to filter, open one

commands.name: rename
commands.summary: name the open chat: /chats lists it by that name

commands.name: export
commands.summary: write the open chat as Markdown into the project's .keel/chats/<id>.md: every message, with role and time

commands.name: compact
commands.summary: summarise the open chat into a fresh session: every stored message stays

commands.name: fix
commands.summary: the last error (or what you describe) to KeelBot: it finds the cause and proposes the fix as buttons you press

commands.name: new
commands.summary: a new KeelBot chat

commands.name: mode
commands.summary: KeelBot's mode: ask (reads only), edit (changes the project folder, no flow needed), fix (at a gate), side (its own branch)

commands.name: changes
commands.summary: the files KeelBot changed in this chat (Fix, Side), with their diffs

commands.name: keep
commands.summary: keep KeelBot's change: the checks run, then keel commits it (one file, or all)

commands.name: undo
commands.summary: undo KeelBot's last answer: every file it changed goes back and your question comes back into the prompt (again: the answer before); a path or all puts only files back

commands.name: redo
commands.summary: put back the answer /undo took (until you send a new message)

commands.name: panel
commands.summary: show a panel, or none (keys: Ctrl+F, Ctrl+A, Ctrl+N toggle them)

commands.name: clear
commands.summary: clear the screen (keel's name and the start stay)

commands.name: copy
commands.summary: copy the last answer (or the n-th block from the end) to your clipboard

commands.name: thinking
commands.summary: KeelBot's thinking: open or fold it while it works, or show the last answer's (Ctrl+T)

commands.name: sidebar
commands.summary: the sidebar on a wide terminal (120 columns or more): the chat's context and cost, the flow, KeelBot's MCP servers, the files this answer changed (Ctrl+B)

commands.name: mouse
commands.summary: on: the wheel scrolls keel TUI and selecting text copies it; off: the terminal's own selection

commands.name: theme
commands.summary: keel TUI's colours for a dark or a light background, or auto (colours that read on both); with no word, the active colour overrides (KEEL_TUI_COLORS)

commands.name: follow
commands.summary: on: this window goes to the project and KeelBot chat the dashboard or another keel TUI opens, and they follow it; off: it keeps its own and moves none of them (kept for the next start)

commands.name: settings
commands.summary: keel TUI's settings with their values now: follow other keel windows, the sidebar, the mouse, the theme; Enter changes one

commands.name: editor
commands.summary: write the prompt in your editor ($VISUAL or $EDITOR): what you save comes back into the prompt, Enter sends it (Ctrl+X E opens the prompt as it is)

commands.name: quit
commands.summary: leave keel TUI (keel keeps running)

keys.does: complete the command or its argument
in an empty prompt: your earlier prompts of this project, newest first (kept by keel); Esc or typing leaves them; or the completion to take
a new line in the prompt (Shift+Enter where the terminal reports it; Ctrl+J too); Enter sends it all
runs the shell command in the project folder through keel's guard (a command that changes something waits for your OK; Ask mode only reads); its output goes with your next question to KeelBot, once
the prompt in your editor ($VISUAL or $EDITOR), as /editor
the agents (as /agent): follow one, or start your own
toggle the sidebar (on a terminal 120 columns wide or more; keel TUI keeps your choice)
open or fold the last tool call's output (or click it); with none on screen, follow the agent at work (or click it; a click on what waits answers it)
KeelBot's next mode: ask, edit, fix (when a gate waits), side
scroll (also Shift+Up / Down, the wheel, Home and End)

drag over text to put it on the clipboard (past the top or bottom it scrolls); Option-drag (Shift-drag) for the terminal's own selection; /mouse off gives the mouse to the terminal; /copy copies the last answer
stop KeelBot's answer, or cancel a choice
